title: 3.3.4 Lab: Update Scores by Index
description: Reassign one value inside an array by its index to update a score in place. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create a scores array
steps.instructions: Create a variable called scores and assign it an array containing at least four number values.

steps.title: Update the first score by index
steps.instructions: Reassign the value at index 0 using scores[0] = ... . Use index assignment, not push or pop, so the array keeps the same length.

steps.title: Log the whole array
steps.instructions: Use console.log to print the scores array so you can see the updated value.

requirements.title: index assignment present
requirements.description: Code assigns to an array index (non-comparison)
